note: IELTS Speaking question bank. Add or edit freely; ids must stay unique. topic/tags drive rotation and review weighting.

questions: Where is your hometown?
What do you like most about your hometown?
Has your hometown changed much in recent years?
Would you like to live there in the future?
Is your hometown a good place for young people?
Do you work or are you a student?
What do you enjoy most about your work or studies?
Is there anything you would like to change about it?
Do you prefer working alone or in a team?
What skills do you need to improve for your job?
How often do you use your phone?
What app do you use the most, and why?
Do you think technology makes life simpler or more complicated?
Is there any technology you would not want to live without?
Do older people in your family use technology much?
What kind of food do you like most?
Do you prefer eating at home or in a restaurant?
Can you cook? Who taught you?
Have your eating habits changed since you were a child?
Is there any food you dislike?
What is the weather like in your city?
Which season do you like best?
Does the weather affect your mood?
Do you check the weather forecast every day?
Has the weather changed compared with ten years ago?
How do you usually travel to work or school?
Is public transport good in your city?
Have you ever been stuck in traffic for a long time?
Would you like to buy a car in the future?
Do you enjoy walking or cycling?
Do you enjoy reading?
What kind of books do you like?
When did you start reading regularly?
Do you prefer paper books or e-books?
Is reading still popular among young people?
What kind of music do you like?
Do you listen to music while working or studying?
Have you ever learned to play an instrument?
When do you usually listen to music?
Would you like to go to a concert?
Do you do any sport or exercise?
How often do you exercise?
Is there a sport you would like to learn?
Do you prefer watching or playing sports?
Do people in your country exercise enough?
Do you like travelling?
What kind of places do you prefer to visit?
Do you prefer travelling alone or with others?
What is the best place you have visited?
Do you want to travel abroad in the future?
Do you enjoy shopping?
Do you prefer shopping online or in shops?
How often do you buy clothes?
Was shopping important to you when you were younger?
Do you ever buy things you do not need?
How many people are there in your family?
Do you spend much time with your family?
Who are you closest to in your family?
Has your family changed in the last few years?
Do you look like anyone in your family?
Do you have a large circle of friends?
How did you meet your best friend?
Is it easy to make new friends where you live?
Do you prefer a few close friends or many acquaintances?
Have your friendships changed since you started working?
What is your usual routine on a weekday?
Are you a morning person or a night owl?
Has your routine changed recently?
What would you like to change about your routine?
Do you plan your day in advance?
How many hours do you sleep at night?
Do you ever feel sleepy during the day?
Do you take naps?
What helps you fall asleep?
Is sleep important for people your age?
Do you like taking photos?
Do you prefer taking photos with a phone or a camera?
Do you ever print your photos?
What do you usually photograph?
Do you think people take too many photos today?
Do you have a pet?
Are pets common in your country?
What animals do you like?
Did you like animals when you were a child?
Do you think it is good for children to grow up with pets?
Which festival do you like most?
How do you usually spend public holidays?
Do you prefer long holidays or several short ones?
Has the way people celebrate changed?
Would you like to experience a festival in another country?

part2.title: Describe a memorable trip you have taken.
bullets: and explain why it was memorable
follow_ups: Do you prefer travelling alone or in a group?
What makes a trip successful?

part2.title: Describe a person who is very good at something.
bullets: and explain why you admire their skill
follow_ups: Are people born with talent or is skill learned?

part2.title: Describe an app or a piece of technology you find very useful.
bullets: how you found out about it
and explain why it is useful to you
follow_ups: Do you think people rely too much on apps?

part2.title: Describe a meal you will never forget.
bullets: and explain why you remember it
follow_ups: Do people in your country cook at home often?

part2.title: Describe a place where you like to relax.
bullets: and explain why it helps you relax
follow_ups: Do people today have enough time to relax?

part2.title: Describe a skill you learned recently.
bullets: why you decided to learn it
and explain how you felt when you could do it
follow_ups: Is it easier to learn new skills when you are young?

part2.title: Describe an object you have kept for a long time.
bullets: and explain why you have kept it
follow_ups: Do young people keep old things today?

part2.title: Describe a film or a book that impressed you.
bullets: when you watched or read it
and explain why it impressed you
follow_ups: Do people read less than before?

part2.title: Describe a job you think is interesting.
bullets: and explain why you find it interesting
follow_ups: What jobs will disappear in the future?

part2.title: Describe a public place in your city that you enjoy visiting.
bullets: and explain why you like it
follow_ups: Do cities need more public spaces?

part2.title: Describe a time when you helped someone.
bullets: and explain how you felt about it
follow_ups: Should children be taught to help others?

part2.title: Describe a game you enjoyed playing when you were a child.
bullets: and explain why you enjoyed it
follow_ups: Do children today play outside enough?

part2.title: Describe a piece of good news you heard recently.
bullets: and explain why it was good news
follow_ups: How do people get news today?

part2.title: Describe a good habit you have or would like to have.
bullets: and explain how you keep it going
follow_ups: Why is it hard to build new habits?

part2.title: Describe someone you admire.
bullets: and explain why you admire them
follow_ups: Do young people have good role models today?

part2.title: Describe a crowded place you have been to.
bullets: and explain how you felt about it
follow_ups: Do you enjoy crowded events?

part2.title: Describe how you have been learning English.
bullets: and explain what has helped most
follow_ups: Is learning a language easier with technology?

part2.title: Describe your ideal home.
bullets: and explain why it is ideal for you
follow_ups: Do people in your country prefer houses or flats?

part2.title: Describe a mistake you made and learned from.
follow_ups: Should children be allowed to make mistakes?

part2.title: Describe a time you bought something online.
bullets: and explain whether you would buy online again
follow_ups: What are the risks of online shopping?

part2.title: Describe an outdoor activity you enjoy.
bullets: and explain why you enjoy it
follow_ups: Do people in your country spend enough time outdoors?

part2.title: Describe a gift you gave to someone.
bullets: and explain how the person reacted
follow_ups: Is it better to give money than a gift?

part2.title: Describe a time when the weather changed your plans.
follow_ups: Is weather forecasting reliable in your country?

part2.title: Describe an important decision you had to make.
bullets: and explain how you feel about it now
follow_ups: Do young people make decisions too quickly?

questions: How has technology changed the way people communicate?
Do you think technology makes people more isolated or more connected?
Should schools limit students' use of phones?
Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs in the future?
What is the most important thing schools should teach?
Should university education be free?
Is it better to study abroad or in your own country?
How has online learning changed education?
What environmental problems are most serious in your country?
Who should take more responsibility: individuals or governments?
Do you think people will use less plastic in the future?
How can cities become greener?
Is work-life balance possible for most people today?
Should companies allow employees to work from home?
Why do some people change jobs frequently?
Is salary the most important thing in a job?
What are the main problems facing large cities today?
Do you think people will move back to smaller towns?
How can public transport be improved?
Should old buildings be preserved in city centres?
How have family roles changed in the last fifty years?
Should grandparents help raise children?
Do people spend enough time with their families today?
Is it common for several generations to live together in your country?
How do people get their news nowadays?
Can you trust information on social media?
Is traditional media still important?
Should governments regulate online content?
What are the positive and negative effects of tourism?
Should popular tourist sites limit visitor numbers?
Is it better to travel independently or on a tour?
How can tourism benefit local communities?
Why are lifestyle diseases increasing?
Should governments tax unhealthy food?
Is mental health taken seriously enough today?
How can people be encouraged to exercise more?
Why do people buy things they do not need?
Is advertising to children acceptable?
Do you think people are more materialistic than before?
How can we reduce waste from packaging?
Why is it important to preserve traditional culture?
Is globalisation making cultures more similar?
Should governments fund the arts?
How can young people learn about their own culture?
What challenges does an ageing population create?
Should people retire later than they do now?
How can older people stay active in society?
Are young people and old people very different today?
